title: Vitthāro
text: 2. Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ || la-pe || paññindriyaṃ || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcindriyāni || || 3. Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam indriyānaṃ samattā paripūrattā arahaṃ hoti || tato mudutarehi antarāparinibbāyī hoti || tato mudutarehi upahacca parinibbāyī hoti || tato mudutarehi asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti || tato mudutarehi sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti || tato mudutarehi uddhaṃsoto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī || tato mudutarehi sakadāgāmī hoti || tato mudutarehi sotāpanno hoti || tato mudutarehi dammānusārī hoti || tato mudutarehi saddhānusārī hotīti || ||
